note: Set-up: white side up, diamond. https://origami.me/squirrel/
1: Precrease the vertical diagonal.
2a: Bring the upper left edge to the center.
2b: Bring the upper right edge to the center.
3: Precrease the right corner to the center.
4: Reverse the right corner inward.
5a: Precrease the left corner to the center.
5b: Reverse the left corner inward.
6: Precrease the front right lower edge to the center.
7: Reverse the front right corner inward.
8: Fold the right flap upward.
9a: Precrease the front left lower edge to the center.
9b: Reverse the front left corner inward.
9c: Fold the left flap upward.
10: Mountain fold the right half behind the left.
11: Rotate clockwise a quarter turn.
12: Precrease the left shoulder onto the near ear junction.
13: Precrease the bottom edge to the near triangular edge.
14: Precrease the white head along its right edge.
15: Precrease the nose to the shoulder mark.
16: Crimp the prepared neck directly; the hinges meet at the boundary and the white head rotates up while the body stays put.
17: Reverse the white head triangle along its prepared hinge.
18: Reverse the nose back out along its prepared crease.
19: Precrease a short snout tip; top edges align, setback 0.28 base-width units.
20: Reverse the small snout tip inward.
21: Pinch the lower front arm edge where its right-edge bisector meets the bottom.
22: Fold the front arm so the pinch mark reaches the vertical center crease.
23a: Turn over to mirror the other arm.
23b: Fold the back arm to match the front.
23c: Return to the front.
24: Raise the tail on a 60-degree crease from the arm/body intersection, leaving a gap behind the ears.
Presentation: rotate clockwise 22.5 degrees for the sitting profile.
25: Fold the tail tip down and right; free shaping line through normalized (2.68,1.20) and (3.02,1.58).
26: Fold the remaining tail corner inward; free shaping line through normalized (3.42,1.30) and (3.48,1.15).
